title: Trump's 'Board of Peace' Gaza pledge 'a drop in the ocean'
summary: U.S. ​President Donald Trump ​on Thursday said countries had contributed ​more ‌than $7 billion ⁠toward relief ‌in Gaza as part ⁠of his Board of ​Peace effort, though this amount is a "drop in the ocean" compared to the amount needed to rebuild the battered enclave, says Yossi Mekelberg, senior consulting fellow at CHatham House.
